transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um... I came in because, well, most days I just feel like I’m sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. It's just this... heavy, hopeless feeling. Even when I’m around people I know, I just can’t seem to shake it.
How long have you been feeling this way—this heavy, hopeless feeling?

It's been about a year and two months now. It started... well, ever since I had a fall at my HVAC job. It left me with a back injury, and... I don't know, everything just started unraveling after that.
Have you ever had a distinct period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, even if it happened before this past year?

No, I haven't. Um... I've never really felt like that. Even before the fall, I just had normal energy, you know, just enough to get through the workday. I've never had a time where I didn't need sleep or felt unusually energetic like you're saying.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I really have. Um... I used to love doing a lot of different things. Hiking, painting... just tinkering around at the local makerspace. I even used to get a kick out of figuring out a tricky install for work. 

But now... I just don't have it in me. I'll just sit there and stare at my supplies, or I'll ignore calls from people when they reach out. It just... none of it feels worth the effort of even starting anymore.
Have there been times when your back pain was better managed or your stress from work was less, but you still felt just as low and hopeless?

Not really. Um... the back pain hasn't really let up at all since the fall, to be honest. So there hasn't really been a time where it was better managed for me to even tell. It just feels like ever since it happened, the pain and this heavy feeling have both just been constant. I haven't really had a break from either of them.
Before this past year, had you ever gone through a period of at least two weeks where you felt persistently down, hopeless, or lost interest in things, even if it wasn't connected to your injury?

No, I haven't. Um... before all this happened, I was always pretty steady. I mean, everybody has a bad day here and there, but... I never went through anything like this where I felt down or hopeless for weeks on end. It really just started after the fall.

Besides the low mood and loss of interest, have you noticed changes in your sleep or appetite, trouble concentrating, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, or any thoughts of death or wanting to harm yourself?

Well, my eating is definitely all over the place. Um... I’ll usually go most of the day just on coffee, because the thought of food just kind of turns my stomach right now. But then late at night, I end up just picking at whatever’s in the cabinet... not even really tasting it, just eating. So yeah, my appetite has definitely changed.
Have you been having any thoughts of worthlessness or excessive guilt, or any thoughts of death or wanting to harm yourself?

Yeah, I do. Um... I just keep telling myself I’m useless now, because I can’t do my job like I used to. I spend a lot of time just sitting there, replaying things in my head... like every apprentice I feel like I let down, and every unpaid bill sitting on the counter. It just feels like proof that I've ruined everything. 

I don't have any plans to hurt myself or anything like that, though. I just... I just feel incredibly guilty all the time.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing, or remembering things since this all started?

Yeah, I have. Um... things like paperwork and repair diagrams that used to be second nature to me, they just kind of blur together now. I'll just sit there unable to decide something stupid, like... which form to even open first. It's just really hard to focus on any of it.
